x-fc-pending.title: Pending of the spec
x-fc-pending.description: Routes, fields and events the API in production has (see `sources`, each one with the release it was read in) but the snapshot in spec/funnelchat.json does not describe, or describes otherwise than production answers. scripts/generate.mjs adds them to the spec before generating the types, only while the snapshot lacks them or still says what a `while` / `x-fc-replace-while` names: when a new snapshot brings them, generation uses the snapshot and lists the entries of this file that can be deleted.

rules.paths: An operation (method + path) is added only if the snapshot does not have it.
rules.operationPatches: A patch adds properties to the body, or `parameters`, to a snapshot operation. With `while`, only while that operation matches it; without `while`, each one only while the operation lacks it.
rules.webhooks: An event is added if the snapshot does not have it, or replaces it while it matches `x-fc-replace-while`.
rules.responsePatches: A patch replaces the responses of a snapshot operation (every 2xx, and the other codes it brings) only while that operation matches `while`.
rules.components.schemas: The schemas of this layer start with `Pending` so they never clash with the snapshot's.
rules.schemaPatches: A patch adds properties to a snapshot schema, each one only while the schema lacks it.
rules.while: In `while` and `x-fc-replace-while`, a key is a property of the operation (or of the event's `post`), or, when it starts with `/`, a JSON Pointer into it (RFC 6901): the entry applies only while that exact place still holds that value.

sources.accounts-webhooks: accounts v1.4.24 (300cc843, in production on 22-10): back/routes/api/webhooks.php:87-111, back/config/platform-gate.php:244-299 (routes open to keys and the Notifications (webhooks) permissions), Http/Requests/*WebhookSubscriptionRequest.php, Http/Resources/WebhookSubscription*Resource.php, Services/WebhookPermissionRules.php and Catalogs/Areas/*Events.php. Read again in the releases in production on 04-11-2026 (accounts v1.5.97 558332bcf, conversations v1.19.7 4e35ddb83, communities v2.35.5 2be913d4): same routes, bodies and resources in accounts v1.5.97; since then a subscription belongs to the workspace of the key that creates it, and the cap of 50 counts per workspace (Webhook/Http/Controllers/WebhookSubscriptionController.php, `inActiveWorkspace()`). `PUT webhooks/{id}` answers the subscription (Webhook/Http/Controllers/WebhookSubscriptionController.php:228, WebhookSubscriptionResource), which the full unified spec of developers-portal (generated/specs/funnelchat-completa.json, c90565e4 and f5464516) types as `{type: object}`.
sources.conversations-send: conversations v1.19.21 (f2937a713, in production on 05-11-2026; read first in v1.19.7 4e35ddb83): every single send of a key (text, send-message, template, form) answers `200 {message}` with the message it registered, never `null` (back/app/Modules/Message/Support/AcceptedSendAnswer.php:91 and Support/ApiKeySendResponse.php:40-43; notes and the Nova channel the same). the full unified spec of developers-portal (generated/specs/funnelchat-completa.json, c90565e4 and f5464516) documents it as nullable: conversations' docs extension (Shared/PublicApi/Docs/ApiKeySendResponsesOperationExtension.php:54 and :317-320, `nullableMessage`) kept the `null` of the read-back the first version had (f2467e639).
sources.conversations-status: conversations v1.19.21 (f2937a713, in production on 05-11-2026; read first in v1.19.7 4e35ddb83): data of message.status_changed (back/app/Modules/Webhook/Payloads/MessageStatusChangedPayload.php:161-189). the full unified spec of developers-portal (generated/specs/funnelchat-completa.json, c90565e4 and f5464516) types it from one example only (`schema: {type: object}`): `status` as any string and `client_reference` never null.
sources.conversations-forms: conversations v1.18.10 (a580a3d0, in production on 22-10): WhatsApp forms (back/routes/api/whatsapp-forms.php, WhatsappForm/Http/Controllers/WhatsappFormController.php, WhatsappFormSendController.php, Http/Resources/WhatsappFormResource.php, Webhook/Payloads/WhatsappFormCompletedPayload.php:118-136). Read again in the releases in production on 04-11-2026 (accounts v1.5.97 558332bcf, conversations v1.19.7 4e35ddb83, communities v2.35.5 2be913d4): the payload is byte-identical in conversations v1.19.7; the send route also checks that the contact is of the key's workspace. The full unified spec of developers-portal (c90565e4 and f5464516) types whatsapp_form.completed from one example only: every answer a string and no field null.
sources.communities-events: communities v2.34.52 (6f32f0b4, in production on 22-10): data of the group events (back/app/Modules/Shared/Support/PlatformEvents/PlatformEventCatalog.php:250-309 and Services/*EventPublisher.php), relayed by the unified catalog of accounts v1.4.24 (300cc843). Read again in the releases in production on 04-11-2026 (accounts v1.5.97 558332bcf, conversations v1.19.7 4e35ddb83, communities v2.35.5 2be913d4): group_participant.joined and .left as communities v2.35.5 records them (Shared/Services/GroupWebhookService.php:217-269, `campaign` null for a group without a campaign; Shared/Support/PlatformEvents/PlatformEventParticipant.php) and group_action.completed as the catalog of accounts v1.5.97 relays it (Webhook/Catalogs/Areas/CommunitiesEvents.php:218).
sources.accounts-number-signup: accounts v1.5.97 (558332bcf, in production on 04-11-2026): back/app/Modules/Device/Http/Requests/StoreDeviceRequest.php, StoreConnectLinkRequest.php, Http/Resources/ConnectLinkResource.php, Http/Resources/DeviceResource.php (`connection` and `external_reference`), Http/Controllers/DeviceProvisioningController.php and config/services.php `connect_links` (the QR every 5 seconds, 10 minutes to scan it from the page, and `meta_enabled`, false by default in production: the official sign-up by link answers `503 meta_connect_disabled` there). The device.* events: Webhook/Services/DeviceWebhookEmitter.php:355-552 (the same `device` block in all of them, `connect_link_id` and `reason`) and Webhook/Catalogs/Areas/AccountsEvents.php:27-81 (all seven active). First read in accounts origin/main dc2907b44 on 25-10 (contract 1022-alta-de-numeros v0.2, first in v1.4.38). Not in the published spec yet: its OpenAPI will replace these entries.
sources.conversations-received: conversations v1.19.21 (f2937a713, in production on 05-11-2026; read first in v1.19.7 4e35ddb83): data of message.received (back/app/Modules/Webhook/Payloads/MessageReceivedPayload.php:130-193: `text` and `media` null when absent, phones as `+` and digits or null, `device_id` last). the full unified spec of developers-portal (generated/specs/funnelchat-completa.json, c90565e4 and f5464516) types it from one example: `text` and the phones never null, `media` unknown.
sources.conversations-templates: conversations v1.19.21 (f2937a713, in production on 05-11-2026; read first in v1.19.7 4e35ddb83): `GET templates` answers a page of TemplateResource (back/app/Modules/Message/Http/Controllers/MessageTemplateController.php:194-196, with `additional()` for the quality counts); the full unified spec of developers-portal (generated/specs/funnelchat-completa.json, c90565e4 and f5464516) types its items as `{type: object}`.
sources.accounts-qr: accounts v1.5.97 (558332bcf, in production on 04-11-2026): `GET devices/{device}/qr` answers `{data: {connected, qr_code, expires_in}}` (back/app/Modules/Device/Http/Controllers/DeviceProvisioningController.php:128-146, its `@body`); the full unified spec of developers-portal (generated/specs/funnelchat-completa.json, c90565e4 and f5464516) infers a union of that body, the inner object in three forms and a bare string.
sources.communities-group-action: communities v2.35.5 (2be913d4, in production): `GET groups/actions/{action}` answers `{data: <one action>}` (back/app/Modules/GroupManagement/Controllers/Api/V2/ApiGroupActionController.php:48-62 and Resources/ApiGroupActionResource.php). The full unified spec of developers-portal f5464516 types `data` as an array.

campaign_ids.description: Only delivers the events of these campaigns. An event without a campaign does not pass the filter.

PendingWebhookSubscription.description: A unified webhook subscription. It never carries the secret.

id.description: Identifier of the subscription. Store it when you create it: it is what tells yours apart.

secret.description: The full secret to verify the signature. It is shown only once: store it.

PendingFormNumber.description: A number where the form is published (or being published).

PendingForm.description: One version of a form. `id` is the version; `family_id` is the form itself: the `form_id` you send it with and the `form.id` of `whatsapp_form.completed`.

name.description: The name in Meta (with the `__vN` suffix).

definition.description: The definition of the form (screens and fields). Only in the detail.

draft_id.description: Only in the list: the draft of the family, when it is not this row.

PendingDeviceConnection.description: `qr`: connected by scanning a QR code (not official). `coexistence`: WhatsApp Cloud API together with the WhatsApp Business app. `dedicated`: WhatsApp Cloud API only. `null` when it cannot be told yet.

PendingExternalReference.description: Your own reference for the number (for example the id of your customer). Free text, not unique.

identity.description: The phone in digits, without `+`, or a `…@lid`.

qr_code.description: A PNG image as a data URI, or `null` when the number is already connected.

expires_in.description: Seconds after which to ask for it again: 5 with a QR, 3 while the session starts, 0 once connected. WhatsApp changes the code every few seconds and an old one no longer links: show the latest one and have it scanned right away; do not store or forward a QR.

type.description: `send_message` for a message to the group.

result.description: `{}` while it is open. Sending: `{message: {uid}}`, the id of the message in WhatsApp. Other actions: `{participants: [...]}`, `{group, invite_link}` or `{invite_link}`.

post.description:
A new secret, shown only once; the previous one stops working.

**Not open to API keys:** with a key it answers `403 route_not_available`. Rotate the secret from the panel.

post.description: One of the numbers of the account got connected: by scanning the QR code, by finishing the sign-up of a WhatsApp Cloud number, or through a connect link.

connect_link_id.description: The connect link of this connection, or `null` when it did not come from a link.

post.description: One of the numbers of the account disconnected and can no longer send or receive: a QR session that closed or was protected from a shadow ban, an official number that failed its re-registration, or one disconnected from the panel.

post.description: The quality Meta gives an official number changed (`GREEN`, `YELLOW` or `RED`, as Meta sends them). If it drops, slow down the sends of that number before Meta limits it. Once per change; not when Meta has no quality data.

Meta sets it per business: one notice per number of the account that changed.

rejection_reason.description: Meta's reason in a rejection, or `null`.

post.description: A group action asked through the API finished, such as a message to a group. `action.uuid` is the `action_id` it returned; sending, `result.message.uid` is the id of the message in WhatsApp.

result.description: Sending: `message.uid`; with phones: `participants`; creating or renewing the link: `invite_link`; the rest, empty.

post.description: A person joined one of the account's groups.

campaign.description: `null` when the group is not of a campaign.

identity.description: The phone, or a `…@lid` when WhatsApp does not show it.

post.description: A person left one of the account's groups.

campaign.description: `null` when the group is not of a campaign.

identity.description: The phone, or a `…@lid` when WhatsApp does not show it.

post.description: A contact wrote to one of the WhatsApp numbers of the account.

id.description: The id of the message in the history of the contact.

text.description: `null` when the message has no text (a file without caption, say).

phone.description: `+` and digits, or `null` when the contact has no phone (a `@lid`, say).
The phone of your number that received it, `+` and digits.

device_id.description: The number of your account that received the message: the same `device_id` you send to reply through it. `null` when the message has no number.

post.description: The delivery status of a message you sent with the API changed. One notice per transition, never one that goes back; `queued` is not reported. It must be asked for explicitly in `events`.

message_id.description: The `id` of the message in the history of the contact.

device_id.description: The number of your account that sent the message.

error.description: Only when `status` is `failed`. Why it failed. When Funnelchat stopped it, `code` is `null` and `reason` says why; when it failed in WhatsApp, `code` and `title` are the provider's and `reason` is `null`.

client_reference.description: The `client_reference` you sent with the message, or `null`.

post.description: A contact completed a form you sent them.
